lines: Hey, human!↓That’s a face I haven’t seen before!
I’m a demon.↓A debt collector who squeezes money outta gambling-addicted trash like you.
If you can’t pay up, I’ll be collecting your soul instead. Better keep that in mind.
Well then, let’s get this collection started.
Good to see you’re still alive and kicking.
Still obsessed with gambling, huh？↓Honestly… what a fool you are.
Well, whatever. As long as you’ve got money, I don’t care.
Even in hell, money talks… isn’t that what they say?
How’re you feeling today?
“Not a single cloud in the sky today.↓Perfect weather for going outside, you know?
You’re not going outside? …Heh, guess you can’t.
You’re pretty good at gambling, huh?
Got some kind of trick for winning?
…‘Paying to cheat,’ is that it?
Well, it’s your money. Spend it however you want...
Just make sure you leave my cut.
Not bad.
Well, I’ll let you off the hook this time.
But next time, I’m taking a whole lot more from you.
If you don’t wanna die, you’d better struggle as hard as you can...human.
Thanks as always～
“At this rate, you might actually pay off your debt someday.
Well, do your best… while you still can.
What the hell? You’re short on cash!
This isn’t even enough to entertain me.
You’re finished. Regret it all in the afterlife.
What, that’s all you’ve got?
You’re a pretty boring bastard.
Hopefully the next human’s a little more interesting.
...You’re still here?
